instruction: Make two local folders in the Thunderbird email client: SUPPORT and SALES.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders (SUPPORT and SALES) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder files and .msf index files exist for both folders using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to capture final state via 'ls -R' on Thunderbird's Local Folders directory
check_list metric properly receives rules dict via get_rule when expected.type='rule'
Regex patterns correctly verify both requirements: (1) SUPPORT.msf and SALES.msf index files, (2) SUPPORT/ and SALES/ folder directories
Negative lookahead pattern '\bSUPPORT/?(?!\.msf)' correctly matches folder name without matching the .msf file
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements verified (both SUPPORT and SALES folders)
Semantic correctness: Patterns match Thunderbird's folder structure (folder + .msf file per local folder)
Data flow correct: ls output -> cache file -> check_list -> regex matching on all 4 patterns
